_doc: Field landmarks, any map: one FIELD_PERF and one MARKS_PERF from the owning AI, the team-link Landmarks view loads landmarks.txt (header, trailer, map name and the map.txt fingerprint checked), every position has an opening, one [MarksCard] line per position, then the screenshot series (each phase window, one card per position label, the legend). Stage gui_barb_team_link.lua plus marks_watch.lua, pass --shots "" and --mode visual.

forbid.pattern: FIELD: worker failed|FIELD: check failed|MARKS: check failed|\[MarksCheck\] FAIL
Error in.*BARb team link|Failed to load.*gui_barb_team_link|\[BARb link\] message error|Error in.*BARb landmarks check
